observations.claim: CANO has a publicly crawlable homepage positioned around abogado penalista CDMX and authority-insider experience.
CANO has a dedicated publicly crawlable delitos fiscales y financieros page addressing defraudacion fiscal, SAT/UIF/Fiscalia, representatives and accountants.
CANO has a publicly crawlable trajectory page documenting Procuraduria Fiscal experience.
CANO has a publicly crawlable cases page including a fiscal-crime defense example.
Rendon Penalistas publishes a dedicated page for a family member at the Ministerio Publico, including audiencia inicial and urgent-defense information.
Abogados en CDMX publishes a dedicated detained-rights guide and a criminal-law specialty hub.
Villalobos Penalistas publishes a detention-emergency oriented criminal-defense landing page.
This public-search cut did not surface a distinct CANO URL dedicated specifically to detenido, citatorio or audiencia inicial. Absence in this search is not proof that no such URL exists.
Exact Google positions Top 3/Top 5 are not established by this evidence because CANO Search Console or an authorized SERP tracker is not connected.

currentPublicContentDocuments.text: CANO Estrategia Penal. Abogado penalista en CDMX. Experiencia desde dentro de la autoridad. Defensa penal, citatorio, detenido, victima, diagnostico y estrategia.

Delitos fiscales y financieros. Auditorias, requerimientos, SAT, UIF, Fiscalia, defraudacion fiscal, operaciones inexistentes, contrabando, lavado, representantes legales y contadores. Defensa temprana.
Eduardo Cano. Experiencia desde 2006 en Delitos Fiscales y Financieros de la Procuraduria Fiscal de la Federacion y litigio penal acusatorio.
Casos de defensa penal, incluyendo defensa en delito fiscal, homicidio, administracion fraudulenta, abuso sexual, despojo y corrupcion.
Homicidio y delitos violentos. Defensa ante detencion, primeras horas, cadena de custodia, periciales, testimonios y audiencias.
